about: Generated by npm run boxes from boxes/parts/ and the running app. Do not edit by hand.

admin-panel.name: Admin panel
admin-panel.does: The admin page: its sign-in, sections, and the overview of how the site is set up.
admin-panel.checkedBy: Browser journeys on the sandbox (visitor and staff paths), and the whole-page build comparison.

admin-sign-in.name: Admin sign-in
admin-sign-in.does: The admin password and sessions, and the guard every admin-only route stands behind.
admin-sign-in.checkedBy: test/api.test.js signs in, is locked out and changes the password.

admin-tools.name: Activity and health
admin-tools.does: The admin activity log, a test email, the site health card and the overview counts.

agri-catalogue.name: Agriculture catalogue
agri-catalogue.does: The agriculture products: the public pages, the team editing them, photos and specifications.

ai-access.name: AI access
ai-access.does: The performance log for an AI: read-only keys, the on and off switch, and the manager asking a model on their own computer.

analytics.name: Visitor counts
analytics.does: The site's own counts: no cookies, no third party, no IP address kept. Answers the Traffic and Insights screens.

branding.name: Logo and tagline
branding.does: The logo and tagline every page shows.

certificates.name: Certificates
certificates.does: Certifications with proof: the file, validity, expiry reminders, and the list on the public pages.

contact.name: Company details
contact.does: The address, emails and phone numbers. Phone numbers reach a visitor only when they press a call or WhatsApp button.
contact.checkedBy: test/api.test.js checks numbers never appear in public responses.

deploy-tools.name: Deploy and upkeep
deploy-tools.does: Deploying, restarting, backing up, the uptime check, and preparing images at build time.

email.name: Email delivery
email.does: The mail account the site sends from, and sendEmail, which every box that writes to someone goes through.

enquiries.name: Enquiries arriving
enquiries.does: A buyer sends an enquiry: it is checked, saved before any email is tried, routed to its team, and acknowledged.

enquiry-work.name: Working enquiries
enquiry-work.does: The inboxes, pipeline, replies, quotes, buyers and files, for the teams and the manager.

facts-spreadsheet.name: Facts spreadsheet
facts-spreadsheet.does: The catalogue facts as a spreadsheet: download, fill in, import with a preview, saved whole or not at all.

home-page.name: Home page
home-page.does: The first page: both businesses, the product strip and the company in brief.
home-page.checkedBy: Browser journeys on the sandbox (visitor and staff paths), and the whole-page build comparison.

home-panels.name: Home panels
home-panels.does: The two business panels: the green agriculture panel with its four product-line tiles and the packaging panel with its products standing in 3D (a box opens its lid under the pointer), side by side on the home page and each again as the first screen of its own page, and the trip between them (the chosen panel grows to fill the screen, the other is pushed off its side).
home-panels.checkedBy: Filmed frame by frame on the sandbox (desktop and phone, both panels, there and back: vt-film.mjs in the olira-verify skill); the crawl checks the pages.

image-upload.name: Image upload
image-upload.does: Makes an uploaded picture safe and small: everything, SVG included, is redrawn as WebP.
image-upload.checkedBy: test/api.test.js uploads a logo and a product photo through it.

lead-store.name: Enquiry store
lead-store.does: Where enquiries are kept: a database when there is one, a file otherwise, so a buyer is never lost.

manager-reports.name: Manager reports
manager-reports.does: The manager's dashboard, team performance, report and product completeness.

marketing-tags.name: Marketing tags
marketing-tags.does: The optional Google Analytics and Ads tags. Nothing from Google loads until an ID is saved.
marketing-tags.checkedBy: test/api.test.js saves integrations with and without a session.

mockup-studio.name: Mockup studio
mockup-studio.does: A visitor sees their brand on a product, as a photo or a 3D package, and sends the design with their request.

packaging-3d.name: 3D packaging
packaging-3d.does: A packaging product in 3D at its own measurements: it folds, opens and lays flat, wears the visitor's logo or artwork, and shows on the website only when both the packaging team and the manager have switched it on.

packaging-catalogue.name: Packaging catalogue
packaging-catalogue.does: The packaging products: rules, photos, sizes, minimums, prices, the public catalogue and the team editing it.

packing-list.name: Packing list
packing-list.does: Several products, sizes and quantities gathered into one quote request.
packing-list.checkedBy: test/catalogue.test.js checks bundles on the server; browser journeys use the list.

page-speed.name: Real page speed
page-speed.does: How fast the site is for real visitors, measured in their browsers and kept only as counts.
page-speed.checkedBy: test/ai-log.test.js reads the measures; test/ai-access.test.js sends them through the beacon.

partners.name: Partner logos
partners.does: The partner logos on the home page, looked after by the marketing teams.
partners.checkedBy: test/workspace.test.js covers who may change them.

product-pages.name: Product cards and pages
product-pages.does: The product card, grid, details panel and page that both catalogues share, and the facts each one shows.
product-pages.checkedBy: test/catalogue-grid.test.js reads its facts; browser journeys open the pages.

search-verification.name: Search verification
search-verification.does: Proves to Google and others that the site is ours.

seo.name: Search and AI listings
seo.does: What search engines and AI assistants read: structured data, FAQ, sitemap and llms.txt.

site-basics.name: Site basics
site-basics.does: Small shared facts: who is calling, what counts as a bot, the site address, clean form text.
site-basics.checkedBy: Used on every request; exercised through test/api.test.js.

site-data.name: Site data for the build
site-data.does: Reads the live data folder when the pages are built, so they carry the current facts.
site-data.checkedBy: scripts/pipeline-test.mjs builds real pages from changed data.

site-health.name: Site health check
site-health.does: The address an uptime monitor watches: folders writable, build present, enquiry store answering.

site-log.name: Performance log
site-log.does: Gathers the figures for the AI data log and keeps one line of main figures per day, for trends.

site-shell.name: Site frame
site-shell.does: What every public page shares: the layout, header, footer, theme, motion and the site's design tokens.

social-links.name: Social links
social-links.does: The social pages and WhatsApp link. The public list leaves the WhatsApp number out.
social-links.checkedBy: test/workspace.test.js and test/api.test.js cover both lists.

staff-accounts.name: Staff accounts
staff-accounts.does: Who may sign in to the workspaces, with which role, and the guards the staff routes stand behind.
staff-accounts.checkedBy: test/workspace.test.js signs in as each role and checks what each may reach.

staff-ui.name: Staff look and parts
staff-ui.does: What the staff screens share: the look, the API helper, charts, number formats and the unsaved-changes guard.
staff-ui.checkedBy: test/staff-numbers.test.js reads its formats; browser checks use every screen.

staging.name: Staging copy
staging.does: The password-protected copy of the site: kept out of search engines and never mails real people.

startup.name: Start-up
startup.does: What happens once when the server really starts: a masked settings summary, safety checks, listening.

static-site.name: Pages and files
static-site.does: Serves the built pages and uploads, sets how long browsers keep them, and answers the 404 and any server error.

storage.name: Storage and logs
storage.does: Where everything is kept: the data and upload folders, safe file writes, the audit log and the error log.

targets.name: Monthly targets
targets.does: The month's targets per line, and progress against them.

team-workspace.name: Team workspace
team-workspace.does: The workspace page for each team and the manager: its sections and sign-in check.
team-workspace.checkedBy: Browser journeys on the sandbox (visitor and staff paths), and the whole-page build comparison.

thumbs.name: Small photos
thumbs.does: Small copies of catalogue photos, made once and kept.

web-guards.name: Web guards
web-guards.does: What stands in front of every request: one site address, security headers, allowed origins, rate limits.

wiring.name: The wiring
wiring.does: Connects every box. server.js plugs them in one line at a time, the board records what each was given, and the boxes tool saves and checks the map.
